name: Right
overview: Scripture reveals that being 'right' encompasses both righteous living and a proper heart orientation before God. Ecclesiastes highlights the wise man's heart as being at his right hand, symbolizing discernment and moral clarity, while Jesus commands loving God with all one's heart, soul, and mind, emphasizing wholehearted devotion. The righteous are promised eternal life, contrasting with punishment for the unrighteous, underscoring the eternal significance of doing what is right. Furthermore, Christ exemplifies right judgment by seeking not His own will but the Father's, modeling submission to God's perfect will as the foundation of true righteousness.
